highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates the engine to m153 and improves GPU text and failure handling.
highlights_body: Linux font fallback can choose a different face. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.2.1.300 while its native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1.

breaking.title: Pin fonts when Linux fallback must be deterministic
breaking.body: Fontconfig fallback now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort path. Applications relying on the exact fallback face may see different glyphs or text metrics; select an explicit family/style or bundle a typeface when deterministic selection matters. This is a behavior change, not a managed API or native ABI change.

bullets.detail: Advances the bundled renderer to milestone m153. The HarfBuzzSharp .300 package revision distinguishes this Skia milestone and does not upgrade native HarfBuzz.

Corrects partial glyph-atlas generation tracking, propagates native Ganesh task/flush/submission failures, and rejects draws after failed buffer uploads under memory pressure. Existing managed flush calls remain void.
Releases the cached-data mutex guard before deleting its owner, avoiding an unlock through freed storage.

Removes command-line truncation-warning suppression from libHarfBuzzSharp so dependent applications no longer need a BinSkim BA2007 baseline for that DLL. Other reported BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 introduced Skia m153, the Linux font-fallback selection change, and a cached-data lifetime fix. HarfBuzzSharp moved to the .300 package revision without a native engine upgrade.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: Release Candidate 1 advanced the release process without adding consumer-facing changes to Preview 1.

harfbuzz_summary: The Windows native DLL now passes BinSkim BA2007 without changing its exported ABI or the bundled HarfBuzz version. Other existing BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 Preview 1 introduces Skia m153 and changes Linux font-fallback selection.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: Release Candidate 1 carries forward Preview 1 without additional consumer-facing changes.

v4.153.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 adds GPU atlas and buffer-upload corrections to the release candidate.
